<function name="PostDrawViewModel" parent="WEAPON" type="hook">
	<description>
Called after the view model has been drawn while the weapon in use.

This hook relies on default implementation of <page>GM:PostDrawViewModel</page>. If it appears to not work, it may have been overwritten/broken by the currently active gamemode or other addons.

<page>WEAPON:ViewModelDrawn</page> is an alternative hook which is always called before <page>GM:PostDrawViewModel</page>.

See also <page>WEAPON:PreDrawViewModel</page>.

<rendercontext hook="true" type="3D"></rendercontext>

	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="vm" type="Entity">This is the view model entity after it is drawn</arg>
		<arg name="weapon" type="Weapon">This is the weapon that is from the view model (same as self)</arg>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The owner of the view model</arg>
		<arg name="flags" type="number" added="2025.12.16">The <page text="STUDIO_">Enums/STUDIO</page> flags for this render operation.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
